requirements.name: Npcf_PolicyAuthorization_Create service operation / General

cases.what: The library sends the Create request (POST to the app-sessions collection) with the media components supplied by the caller.
The library carries the caller-built media components, including fStatus, in the Create request; it does not set fStatus itself.

cases.case: - Initial Background Data Transfer policy indication.
cases.what: The library never provides a Background Data Transfer reference id.

cases.case: - Initial provisioning of sponsored connectivity information.
cases.what: The library does not provide a sponsor identity or application service provider identity; it only sends sponStatus SPONSOR_DISABLED.

cases.case: - Subscription to Service Data Flow QoS notification control.
cases.what: The library subscribes to QOS_NOTIF in the events list of the Create request when the caller sets that event in the events mask.

cases.case: - Subscription to Service Data Flow Deactivation.
cases.what: The library subscribes to FAILED_RESOURCES_ALLOCATION in the events list of the Create request when the caller sets that event in the events mask.

cases.case: - Initial provisioning of traffic routing information.
cases.what: The library does not provide traffic routing information: it sets no afRoutReq and negotiates no feature.
The library subscribes to SUCCESSFUL_RESOURCES_ALLOCATION and FAILED_RESOURCES_ALLOCATION in the events list of the Create request when the caller sets them in the events mask.
The library never invokes Multimedia Priority Services: it sets no mpsId or mpsAction.
The MediaComponentVersioning feature is not negotiated: the library always sends suppFeat 0.
The NetLoc feature is not negotiated and the library never sets reqAnis; it can only request the ANI_REPORT event with notification method EVENT_DETECTION.

cases.case: - Initial provisioning of service information status.
cases.what: The library never sets servInfStatus (service information status).
The ProvAFsignalFlow feature is not negotiated: the library always sends suppFeat 0.
The ResourceSharing feature is not negotiated: the library always sends suppFeat 0.
The library never indicates emergency traffic: it sets no servUrn.
The library never invokes MCPTT: it sets no mcpttId and does not negotiate the MCPTT feature.
The library never invokes MCVideo: it sets no mcVideoId and does not negotiate the MCVideo feature.
The PrioritySharing feature is not negotiated: the library always sends suppFeat 0.

cases.case: - Subscription to out of credit notification.

cases.case: - Subscription to Service Data Flow QoS Monitoring information.

requirements.name: Npcf_PolicyAuthorization_Create service operation / Initial provisioning of service information

cases.case: Set up an AF application session context
cases.what: The library sets up an AF application session context by sending the Create request to the PCF.

cases.case: POST to the Application Sessions collection
cases.what: The library sends an HTTP POST to the app-sessions collection of the PCF with the media components the caller supplies.
The library sends an AppSessionContext whose ascReqData is an AppSessionContextReqData.
For an IPv4 UE address the library sends it in ueIpv4.
For an IPv6 UE address the library stores a /128 prefix but sends no ueIpv6, because the request builder reads a session field that is never assigned.

cases.case: - for Ethernet type PDU sessions, the MAC address of the UE in the "ueMac" attribute.
cases.what: The library never sends ueMac: it takes only an IP address for the UE and has no Ethernet PDU session support.

cases.case: ueMac of DS-TT port (Ethernet, TSN or TSC)
cases.what: The TimeSensitiveNetworking and TimeSensitiveCommunication features are not negotiated and the library never sends ueMac.

cases.case: UE IP address from TSC user plane node report
cases.what: The TimeSensitiveCommunication feature is not negotiated and the library does not take the UE address from a TSC user plane node report.
The library sends the media components supplied by the caller in medComponents.
The library carries the caller-built media components, including fStatus, unchanged; it does not set or require fStatus itself.
The AuthorizationWithRequiredQoS feature is not negotiated: the library always sends suppFeat 0.
The library never sets afAppId in AppSessionContextReqData.
The library never sets afAppId at AppSessionContextReqData level.
A caller can set afAppId in the MediaComponent entries, which the library sends unchanged.
The library never sets afAppId at AppSessionContextReqData level, so it cannot trigger application detection this way.
The IMS_SBI feature is not negotiated: the library always sends suppFeat 0.
The TimeSensitiveNetworking and TimeSensitiveCommunication features are not negotiated and the library provides no TSC information.
The library includes evSubsc (EventsSubscReqData) in the Create request.
The library puts the events (from the caller's events mask, notification method EVENT_DETECTION) in the events attribute of evSubsc.
The library puts a notification URL of its own notification server in the notifUri attribute of evSubsc.
The library sends notifUri in AppSessionContextReqData, set to the URL of its own notification server for the session.
The library does not serve a deletion request from the PCF on that URI: its notification server answers only the event notification and returns 400 to any other operation.
For an IPv4 UE address the library sends it in ueIpv4.
For an IPv6 UE address the library stores a /128 prefix but sends no ueIpv6, because the request builder reads a session field that is never assigned.
The library never sends ueMac: it takes only an IP address for the UE and has no Ethernet PDU session support.
The library never sends dnn: the Create builder copies a session field that nothing assigns, and the dnn in the caller's UE identifier is stored but never forwarded.
The library never sends supi: the Create builder copies a session field that nothing assigns, and the supi in the caller's UE identifier is stored but never forwarded.
The library never sends gpsi: the Create builder copies a session field that nothing assigns, and the gpsi in the caller's UE identifier is stored but never forwarded.
The library offers no way to give an S-NSSAI and never sends sliceInfo.

cases.case: The NF service consumer may also provide the domain identity in the "ipDomain" attribute.
cases.what: The library never sends ipDomain: the value in the caller's UE identifier is stored but no builder reads it.
After an error response to Create the library removes the session and reports the failure to the caller; it never resends the same service information by itself.
The library does not read the Retry-After header, so it cannot hold a caller back until the retry interval has elapsed.
The library sends the media subcomponents the caller supplies, including the IP flow descriptions in fDescs.
The library sends the media subcomponents the caller supplies, including ethfDescs if the caller sets it.
